ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotio.en: I've got to buy some POTIONS.\pYou never know when your POKéMON\nwill need quick healing.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotio.fr: Je dois acheter des POTIONS.\pOn ne sait jamais quand ses POKéMON\nauront besoin de soins rapides.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParce.en: {PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL\nfrom the POKéMON MART clerk.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParce.fr: {PLAYER} a reçu le COLIS DE CHEN\ndu vendeur de la BOUTIQUE POKéMON.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe.en: Okay, thanks! Please say hi to\nPROF. OAK for me, too.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe.fr: D'accord, merci ! Salue aussi le\nPROF. CHEN de ma part.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusin.en: This shop does good business in\nANTIDOTES, I've heard.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusin.fr: Cette boutique fait de bonnes\naffaires avec les ANTIDOTES,\lparaît-il.

ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak.en: You know PROF. OAK, right?\pHis order came in.\nCan I get you to take it to him?
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak.fr: Tu connais le PROF. CHEN, n'est-ce\npas ?\pSa commande est arrivée.\nPeux-tu la lui apporter ?
